questions.question: How would you rate your overall study abroad experience? *
Additional comments:
questions.answer: It was a really bad experience. The university and its professors were highly unprofessional and very rude. It felt like being back in school, we were treated like little kids and spoken very rudely to. We weren't given material to study in and out of class, but were instead expected to write down everything the teacher said, this was supposed to be our material to study for the exams and in general. They wouldn't share any powerpoint slides and if anyone took a picture of the powerpoints in class, they would be yelled at and asked to delete it. During exams we weren't allowed to go to the bathroom, and mind you it was nearing 40 degree weather, so in order to stay properly hydrated, it was really difficult not to go pee during a highly stressful 2,5 hour exam.

questions.question: How satisfied were you with the academic programme at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
Were you a BA or MA student at UCPH when you were on exchange? *
questions.answer: BA

questions.question: Did you take BA or MA classes while you were on exchange *
questions.answer: BA

questions.question: Please elaborate on the level of courses *
questions.answer: The classes very extremely childish in the way they were structured but at the same time very inaccessible for the most part to exchange students. Especially when taking 4th year classes, you come into a class where this knowledge has been built for years and you try to catch up on it in your 3rd language and with no help or understanding at all from the professors' side. I tried to explain my situation and if we could be given a bit of grace, but no. For comparison, this has not been my experience at all in my other exchange in Colombia and also not in UCPH. Usually, you would be able to go up and speak with your professor and feel like you're being heard and come to some sort of solution.

questions.question: How did the style of teaching at your host institution compare with that of UCPH? *
questions.answer: It was so bad compared to UCPH. We were not treated like adults or equals in any way, you just have to sit and write down everything the professor says. There is no debate, conversation, interaction. Nobody asks questions and challenging what the professor says is basically unheard of
